interpretation.files_with_errors_metric: Counts extracted project files with at least one extraction error OR warning. This includes warning-only files.
interpretation.files_without_error_metric: Counts extracted project files without extraction errors OR warnings.
interpretation.ExtractionErrors_diagnostic: Only matches actual ExtractionError entries; does not match ExtractionWarning entries.
interpretation.comparison: Therefore 3 with-errors files and zero ExtractionErrors rows in attempt3 are compatible with the 30 warnings across three files. Actual final context metrics must be read separately.

no_inference: No metric here proves every syntax node, macro, type or dataflow is complete.
